lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is your bank's security team calling about your debit card.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We flagged a $499 charge at Walmart in Texas a few minutes ago. Did you make that purchase?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, I have never been to Texas.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Then we need to block it right now, before more charges go through.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To verify your identity, please read me the full card number and the code we just texted you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you. Stay on the line while I secure the account.
